title: Deep Cleaning Bacteria Incubator
author: Kenneth Schackart
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ba2tigen
materials: Reassemble the incubator by reversing the disassembly instructions.

steps.title: Turn off incubator power
steps.instruction: Switch off the incubator by using the power switch located at the bottom of the unit.

steps.title: Remove incubator door
steps.instruction: Loosen the interior hinge screws while holding the door, slide the door outward to release the top hinge, retain the small plastic bushings that sit between each hinge and the incubator, and set the door and bushings aside on the lab bench.

substeps.instruction: Slide door outward to release top hinge
Place door and bushings on bench

steps.title: Remove rack shelving
steps.instruction: Pull the rack shelving straight outward from the incubator and set it aside on the lab bench.

steps.title: Remove shelf holders
steps.instruction: Record the position of each shelf, then for each horizontal shelf holder lift it up, rotate the bottom upward/outward, and slide the top downward and out; place the holders on the bench.

steps.title: Remove vertical mounts
steps.instruction: Note the orientation of each vertical mount, then remove the two screws holding each mount and set the mounts aside on the bench.

steps.title: Remove bottom tray
steps.instruction: Undo the two screws securing the bottom tray, insert a small curved metal pick into the tray holes to help lift the back end if needed, lift the tray straight up, and set it aside on the bench.

substeps.instruction: Insert curved metal pick if needed

steps.title: Wash interior with VersaClean
steps.instruction: Dip a sponge in VersaClean solution (or another laboratory cleaner; do NOT use bleach on stainless steel), scrub each interior surface starting with the top, then the sides, and finally the bottom, wring the sponge into a waste container and re‑wipe each surface so it is only slightly damp, avoiding the mechanical moving parts on the bottom.

substeps.instruction: Re‑wipe to leave surfaces slightly damp

steps.title: Spray interior with ethanol
steps.instruction: Spray all interior surfaces with ethanol, then wipe them with paper towels; avoid directly spraying the mechanical moving parts on the bottom.

steps.title: Clean door and removable parts
steps.instruction: Using a sponge with VersaClean, wash the door, rack mounts, racks, and shelf holders; immediately spray these components with ethanol and wipe with paper towels before reinstalling.

substeps.instruction: Wash door and parts with VersaClean‑soaked sponge

steps.title: Dry incubator completely
steps.instruction: Allow the incubator to air‑dry fully before closing the door or restoring power, noting that ethanol vapour is flammable.
